title: A thief with a soldier’s bearing
literal_meaning: A thief, yet putting on a soldier’s bearing.
meaning_odia: ଚୋର ହୋଇ ମଧ୍ୟ ପାଇକ ପରି ପଣ ଦେଖାଇବା—ଦୁଇଟି ବିପରୀତ ପରିଚୟକୁ କଥାଟି ଏକାଠି ରଖିଛି। ପାଇକର ଶବ୍ଦାର୍ଥ ପଦାତିକ ସୈନ୍ୟ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ, ନିଜେ ଭୁଲ କରି ମଧ୍ୟ ଦମ୍ଭ ବା ବାହାଦୁରି ଦେଖାଇବାର ଆଚରଣ ଏଠାରେ ଉପହାସର ବିଷୟ।
explanation: The opening names wrongdoing; the ending adds a soldierly pose. Read editorially, the line mocks someone who answers their own misconduct with swagger. Its tension lies in the gap between the conduct and the bearing the person puts on.
usage_example: Original imagined example: After admitting that they took something without permission, someone boasts of being too formidable to challenge. A listener quotes the line about a thief displaying soldierly bearing.
cultural_context: ପାଇକ supplies the soldier image, and ପଣ turns it into a quality or bearing. ପୁଣି sharpens the surprise that this display accompanies the identity given at the start.

witnesses.locator: Page18, single line beginning ଚୋର ହୋଇ ପୁଣି.
